ThingShape.description: Base ThingShape for GIT Repository Things providing core Git operations (commit, push, pull, branch, tag, etc.).
ThingShape.name: GIT.Repository.ThingShape

ServiceDefinition.description: Syncs the ThingWorx project entities to the local working tree, stages all changes, and creates a commit. Does not push to the remote.
ServiceDefinition.name: Commit

FieldDefinition.description: The commit message
FieldDefinition.name: Message

ServiceDefinition.description: Exports the configured ThingWorx project directly to this repository.
ServiceDefinition.name: ExportProjectEntities

FieldDefinition.description: Required ThingWorx project name
FieldDefinition.name: ProjectName

FieldDefinition.description: Optional; if not set all project entities will be exported
FieldDefinition.name: EntitiesToExport

FieldDefinition.description: Optional compatibility parameter; committing is handled by Commit.
FieldDefinition.name: commitMessage

ServiceDefinition.description: Imports all XML entities below this repository's configured path into its required ThingWorx project.
ServiceDefinition.name: ImportProjectEntities

FieldDefinition.description: Relative path within this FileRepository; blank uses RepoPathName.
FieldDefinition.name: entityPath

FieldDefinition.description: If true, strips dependency validation during import
FieldDefinition.name: ignoreDependencies

ServiceDefinition.description: Pushes existing local commits to a remote. This service does not synchronize entities, stage files, or create commits. The remote defaults to origin.
ServiceDefinition.name: Push

FieldDefinition.description: Optional remote name; defaults to origin
FieldDefinition.name: Remote

ServiceDefinition.description: Pulls the last commit to the File Repository path
ServiceDefinition.name: Pull

FieldDefinition.description: Forces a hard reset instead of a normal pull
FieldDefinition.name: Force

ServiceDefinition.description: Fetches refs and objects from a remote without merging, checking out, resetting, or synchronizing entities. The remote defaults to origin.
ServiceDefinition.name: Fetch

FieldDefinition.description: Optional remote name; defaults to origin
FieldDefinition.name: Remote

ServiceDefinition.description: Deletes all files from the local repo path including the git configuration files. This operation is needed in case the git operations throw up strange errors. Reinitializes the Git object entirely.
ServiceDefinition.name: DeleteLocalRepoContent

ServiceDefinition.description: Creates a new local branch from an optional start point (commit, branch, or tag) without switching to it.
ServiceDefinition.name: CreateBranch

FieldDefinition.description: Name of the new branch
FieldDefinition.name: BranchName

FieldDefinition.description: Optional: commit hash, branch name, or tag to branch from (defaults to HEAD)
FieldDefinition.name: StartPoint

FieldDefinition.description: Switches the working tree to the specified branch. This is a wrapper on top of checkout <branch>.It does not autocreate new branches.
FieldDefinition.name: BranchNameOrCommit

ServiceDefinition.description: This method deletes a local branch. Used in the case a remote branch was deleted/pruned and you want to remove your local copy.
ServiceDefinition.name: DeleteLocalBranch

FieldDefinition.description: Branch name to be deleted, without the refs/heads/ part
FieldDefinition.name: BranchName

ServiceDefinition.description: Get a list of the commits for the current branch; if the current index is pointing to a commit, then it will return the commit list for the Initial branch configured in the Config section
ServiceDefinition.name: GetCommitList

ServiceDefinition.description: Returns commit history, newest first. Ref is optional and defaults to the current branch, or the configured branch when HEAD is detached. MaxEntries of zero or omitted means no limit.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetLog

FieldDefinition.description: Optional branch, tag, commit, or ref name
FieldDefinition.name: Ref

FieldDefinition.description: Maximum number of entries; zero or omitted means no limit
FieldDefinition.name: MaxEntries

ServiceDefinition.description: Returns local reflog entries, newest first. Reflogs are local to this repository clone and are not remote history. Ref defaults to HEAD; MaxEntries of zero or omitted means no limit.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetReflog

FieldDefinition.description: Optional ref name; defaults to HEAD
FieldDefinition.name: Ref

FieldDefinition.description: Maximum number of entries; zero or omitted means no limit
FieldDefinition.name: MaxEntries

ServiceDefinition.description: Returns Git-conflicted files without synchronizing entities.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetConflictFiles

ServiceDefinition.description: Reads a conflicted repository file for UI editing.
ServiceDefinition.name: ReadConflictFile

FieldDefinition.description: Repository-relative file path
FieldDefinition.name: File

ServiceDefinition.description: Writes a UI-resolved repository file while a merge or rebase is paused.
ServiceDefinition.name: WriteConflictFile

FieldDefinition.description: Repository-relative file path
FieldDefinition.name: File

FieldDefinition.description: Resolved file content
FieldDefinition.name: Content

ServiceDefinition.description: Stages manually resolved files without exporting ThingWorx entities over the edits.
ServiceDefinition.name: StageResolved

FieldDefinition.description: Optional resolved file pattern; omitted stages all changes
FieldDefinition.name: FilePattern

ServiceDefinition.description: Completes a paused merge after conflicts are resolved and staged, then synchronizes ThingWorx.
ServiceDefinition.name: MergeContinue

FieldDefinition.description: Optional merge commit message
FieldDefinition.name: Message

ServiceDefinition.description: Aborts the current merge and synchronizes the restored state into ThingWorx.
ServiceDefinition.name: MergeAbort

ServiceDefinition.description: Continues a paused rebase after conflicts are resolved and staged, then synchronizes ThingWorx.
ServiceDefinition.name: RebaseContinue

ServiceDefinition.description: Skips the current commit in a paused rebase.
ServiceDefinition.name: RebaseSkip

ServiceDefinition.description: Aborts the current rebase and synchronizes the restored state into ThingWorx.
ServiceDefinition.name: RebaseAbort

ServiceDefinition.description: Compatibility service that returns the working-tree diff for one file.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetDiffPerFile

ServiceDefinition.description: This service gets a commit information based on the Commit ID
ServiceDefinition.name: GetCommitInfo

ServiceDefinition.description: Merges the specified branch into the current branch.
ServiceDefinition.name: Merge

FieldDefinition.description: The branch to merge from
FieldDefinition.name: BranchName

ServiceDefinition.description: Rebases the current branch onto the specified upstream branch.
ServiceDefinition.name: Rebase

FieldDefinition.description: The branch or commit to rebase onto
FieldDefinition.name: UpstreamBranch

ServiceDefinition.description: Creates a lightweight or annotated tag on the specified commit (defaults to HEAD).
ServiceDefinition.name: CreateTag

FieldDefinition.description: Name of the tag to create
FieldDefinition.name: TagName

FieldDefinition.description: Optional tag message (creates annotated tag)
FieldDefinition.name: Message

FieldDefinition.description: Optional commit to tag (defaults to HEAD)
FieldDefinition.name: CommitID

ServiceDefinition.description: Returns all tags in the repository.
ServiceDefinition.name: GetTagList

ServiceDefinition.description: Deletes a tag from the repository.
ServiceDefinition.name: DeleteTag

FieldDefinition.description: Name of the tag to delete
FieldDefinition.name: TagName

ServiceDefinition.description: Selects or clears the current user's signing key for this repository
ServiceDefinition.name: SetGPGKeyForSigning

FieldDefinition.description: Owned GPG fingerprint; blank disables signing
FieldDefinition.name: GpgKeyFingerprint

ServiceDefinition.description: Imports one entity path
ServiceDefinition.name: ImportEntity

FieldDefinition.description: Repository-relative path
FieldDefinition.name: entityPath

FieldDefinition.description: Ignore dependencies
FieldDefinition.name: ignoreDependencies

ServiceDefinition.description: Removes imported last-modified metadata.
ServiceDefinition.name: RemoveLastModifiedDate

ServiceDefinition.description: Removes model persistence provider metadata
ServiceDefinition.name: RemoveModelPersistenceProviderPackage
